author: Pavlo
body:
For some reason I can't access the post with the proper player report layout, so I hope this will do.

I was playing against InfiniteLunacy and the player was getting ridiculous knockback on me, so this made me a bit suspicious. I opened up Bandicam and recorded what I could. 

Apart from extreme knockback, at 16 seconds it also appears that the player got knocked over the edge but came back.

Video: https://youtu.be/gP_me2kE0Ko

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Difference between autoclicker and the "Fast hit" glitch, is that autoclicker provides added knockback due to fast hits, but it only registers so much hits. Those unregistered one are essentially KB hits... if that makes sense.

Fast hit glitch would have killed Pavlo in the air.
